issues.reason: The reviewer's own q2 gap concedes a proper-noun modifier on a common noun is uncovered, and Possession is expressly opaque — it 'covers ownership, kinship, and looser association alike without having to mean ownership' — so an association atom between the assistance and the UN is true and well-typed improvisation in gap territory (calibration line).

Cardinality states that a plural with a distributive predicate 'keeps the group + count + group event for counting / did any?' and ADDS the per-member rule, so the rule-only rendering drops a required emission (Both dogs barked emits both).

The implement event carries no tense/status atom, and the instruction set states that a reified non-finite embedded eventuality 'asserts or denies nothing about occurrence' — the roles are exactly the controller-copying the same pattern prescribes.

Nothing inside a seal is asserted and sealed conjuncts carry no STV of their own (the sealing examples show bare content atoms), so the wrapper's (STV 1.0 0.99) is the truth value of the Theme atom, not of the embedded rules — the missing carrier is the reviewer's own q2 gap, not a parse defect.

gaps_confirmed: a proper-noun modifier on a common noun ('UN assistance') — Compound concepts excludes proper nouns and the genitive rule needs 's / a possessive pronoun, so no attachment is licensed
coordination inside a non-subject argument slot ('assistance and advice') — distributive-by-default is illustrated for whole predications, and two same-role fillers on one event is unaddressed
no truth-value carrier for a conjunct inside a seal — the same structural limitation already registered for a negated conjunct in a sealed complement
a gerund clause as the object of an event-side preposition-named oblique ('in implementing the decisions') — the oblique's object is specified to follow ordinary NP rules
new_gaps: verbatim direct quotation inside a reported complement — nothing records that the sealed proposition was quoted rather than paraphrased
repair_summary: Added the group-level take event — (Member sk_take_1 take) (Patient sk_take_1 sk_decision_1) (Past sk_take_1) — inside the seal beside the existing per-member distribution rule, as Cardinality requires for a definite plural with a distributive predicate; everything else is unchanged.
notes: The group event stays inside the seal because only the definite referent's typing (GroupOf sk_decision_1 decision) projects, and it uses the witness form sk_take_1 against the rule's Skolem-function form (sk_take $x), exactly as the 'Both dogs barked' pattern does. Experiencer/Recipient on tell, the anonymous person witness for 'him', and the definite/indefinite projection split all follow the instruction set.
